title: Rockefeller files: correspondence routed through Hillary Clinton's office

tellings.quote: there was two documents in the Rockefeller files and I couldn't figure out what they were. One said all the stuff going from Rockefeller to the science adviser from science adviser to the Rockefeller is going through the mail the mailbox of Hillary Clinton.

plain: In the 1990s, letters between the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller and the president's science adviser are said to have passed through the mailbox of Hillary Clinton, then the First Lady. The researcher Grant Cameron says he found this in two puzzling documents among the Rockefeller files, papers from Rockefeller's contacts with the Clinton White House, one of which said all the mail going each way went through her mailbox. If so, it would put the First Lady at the centre of those exchanges.
